name: platewright.household.get
description: Read the household settings and each member (or one member, by id) with their constraints and each constraint's state on a date (default today, in the household time zone).

name: platewright.ingredients.search
description: Search the ingredient table by name or alias, allergen-free, diet, tag or content flag. Each row has allergens, may-contain, flags, units, density or weight per piece and nutrition per 100 g.

name: platewright.recipes.search
description: Search recipes by text, ingredient, tags, total time, allergen-free (strict: also leaves out may-contain) and diet; archived recipes only when include_archived is true. Filters look at every line, optional ones included.

name: platewright.recipes.get
description: Read a recipe (or an earlier revision) at any number of servings (1 to 200) and in a unit system (recipe = as written, metric, us); `units` asks for one ingredient in a given unit. Each shown quantity carries its exact value. Includes per-serving nutrition, revisions and, for a variant, its base and whether the base has moved on.

name: platewright.recipes.check
description: Check a recipe for members (default: all) and guests on the date of the meal (default today): one verdict per person (unsafe, may_contain, unsuitable, over_limit, disliked, ok_if_omitted or ok) with the lines behind it. Constraints apply as they stand on that date. Not medical advice.

name: platewright.substitutions.list
description: List the substitution rules for an ingredient (ingredient_id) or for each line of a recipe (id), with whether each rule applies to the recipe's method tags and why not.

name: platewright.recipes.variant.preview
description: Preview a recipe with swaps (by rule_id, or a custom to_ingredient_id with a ratio): returns exactly the content recipes.variant.create would save, its nutrition, and the check before and after the swaps. Writes nothing.

name: platewright.plan.get
description: Read the meal plan for a window (start/end dates, default the current week, at most 42 days): each slot with its state, phase (upcoming/past), dishes and servings, attendees, guests, leftovers, history and flags (person verdicts, archived_recipe, stale_base, leftover_short, leftover_expired).

name: platewright.pantry.list
description: Read the pantry with each item's freshness (fresh, use_soon, expired, no_date) and days left on today's date; used-up items only with include_out.

name: platewright.shopping.get
description: Read the current shopping list (or null): derived lines with the slots they are for, manual lines, ticks, exclusions, surplus lines, optional lines, stock expiring before use, and whether the list is stale.

name: platewright.notifications.list
description: List notifications (what other household members did), optionally by date window and kind.

name: platewright.recipes.create
description: Save a new recipe at revision 1 (servings 1 to 200; every quantity positive and in a unit its ingredient is measured in).

name: platewright.recipes.update
description: Edit a recipe through patch, which adds a revision; patch.archived archives (true) or restores (false) it without a new revision. An archived recipe can only be restored; a variant can only be archived or restored.

name: platewright.recipes.variant.create
description: Save a recipe with swaps as a new variant recipe that records its base, the base revision and the swaps; a custom swap marks it unverified. Saves exactly what recipes.variant.preview shows.

name: platewright.members.constraint.set
description: Add a constraint to a member (id = the member's person_id), or replace one by constraint.id; it is kept with its dates, its note and a history row. Omitted dates default to today and no expiry for a new constraint and are kept on a replacement.

name: platewright.members.constraint.remove
description: End a member's scheduled or active constraint from now (id = the member's person_id); its history is kept.

name: platewright.plan.slot.set
description: Set a slot (id = date:meal) with dishes (a recipe at servings, default from the attendees' portion factors plus one per guest, or portions of leftovers from an earlier slot), attendees (default all members) and guests with their constraints; it replaces the slot. No dishes clears it. A dish that is wrong for someone is planned and flagged, not refused.

name: platewright.plan.slot.mark
description: Mark a planned slot cooked (not before its date; records portions made and eaten per recipe, default its servings and its attendees' portions; deduct_pantry takes the exact quantities from the pantry, never below zero, and returns what was short) or skipped.

name: platewright.pantry.set
description: Set the pantry quantity of an ingredient (id = ingredient_id) in a unit it is measured in, and optionally its use-by date (null: none). Quantity 0 marks it used up.

name: platewright.shopping.generate
description: Generate (or regenerate) the shopping list for a window of at most 28 days from the planned slots and the pantry. Manual lines, ticks and exclusions survive; derived lines no longer needed are dropped, or kept as surplus when ticked.

name: platewright.shopping.item.set
description: Without id: add a manual line (ingredient_id or text, quantity, unit). With id: change a manual line, tick or untick a line, or exclude a derived line with a reason (or include it again).

name: platewright.shopping.item.remove
description: Remove a manual line; a derived line is excluded instead (derived_line).
